name: Breitenfelde (Germany)
description: White field with narrow red stripes along the top and bottom edges, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Breitenfelde (a white horse's head on black above red, blue and white stripes).
history: Municipal flag of Breitenfelde; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Breitenfelde arms — horse's head above stripes
